name: Error Humanizer
description: Use Gemini Flash to rewrite generic error messages into witty, human-readable form with the actual error included

target.semantic_description: The compiled JS file that runs the agent runtime, handles external CLI run failures, and constructs fallback error text for failed agent turns

steps.description: Make fallbackText mutable so Gemini can overwrite it
Insert Gemini API call to rewrite error messages
Replace generic sync fallback error with one that includes error detail
steps.pattern: return "[^"]*Something went wrong while processing your request[^"]*";
steps.replacement: return "\u26a0\ufe0f Ran into a hiccup: " + collapseRepeatedFailureDetail(message).slice(0, 200) + ". Try again, or use /new to start fresh.";
